description: Prepaid data-only travel eSIM plans sold by SimOwl for one country or multi-country region: data amount, validity in days, price (taxes included), networks, and a buy_url, cheapest first, e.g. for "eSIM for Morocco for 10 days". min_days filters by trip length and min_data_gb by data amount. Includes regional plans that also cover the country. No phone number or calls. Read-only: it never buys anything. The person buys on the site through the buy_url: the plan opens selected, they enter their email and pay; the QR code arrives by email within minutes.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code to quote prices in (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY...). Defaults to EUR when not sold.

destination.description: Country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code ("Japan", "JP"), or a region ("Europe", "Asia Pacific").

min_data_gb.description: Only plans with at least this much data (unlimited plans always match).

min_days.description: Only plans valid for at least this many days (trip length).

name: find_esim_plans
title: Find travel eSIM plans
